title: Eye-tracking Workshop for Developmental Scientist
description: Our first eye-tracking workshop designed to guide developmental researchers through the complete workflow, from collecting eye-tracking data with infants and children to preprocessing and analyzing gaze data

title: A Practical Introduction to Eye-tracking for Developmental Science
description: Practical workshop focused on designing and implementing developmental eye-tracking studies. Features the first introduction of the DeToX Python package for streamlined data collection with Tobii eye trackers

title: Hands-on Generalized Mixed-Effects Models
description: Pre-BCCCD 2026 conference workshop providing hands-on training in generalized mixed-effects models for analyzing developmental and longitudinal data

title: From Screen to Scene: Shared Principles in Screen-Based and Head-Mounted Eye-Tracking
description: Half-day workshop comparing screen-based and head-mounted eye-tracking in infant research, focusing on shared analytical principles, system choice, AOIs, time windows, preprocessing strategies, and practical examples using real datasets and analysis scripts.
